description: Fetch a block on Base by decimal number, or the latest one when omitted: hash, timestamp, transaction count, gas used and limit, base fee in gwei and producer. Use for timestamps and confirmation counts; for current fees use base_gas. A block that does not exist yet returns 404, uncharged. Example: number=latest. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: base_block
title: Base block
